summary.tldr: Removes excise duty from beer and malt liquor with 0.5% alcohol or less.
what_it_does: Sets the excise duty on beer or malt liquor with 0.5% absolute ethyl alcohol by volume or less at $0 per hectolitre.
Keeps a separate Excise Act schedule item for beer or malt liquor with more than 0.5% and up to 1.2% absolute ethyl alcohol by volume.
summary.background: The bill changes the excise duty schedule in the Excise Act for beer and malt liquor.
